reviews.inspection_scope: All14nativePDFcapturepages visually inspected; printedpp107–116 available; screenshotjoin continuity not fully certified.

sources.title: Zissu and Ganor 2009 - Horvat Ethri - A Jewish Village from the Second Temple Period and the Bar Kokhba Revolt in the Judean Foothills.pdf

reviews.inspection_scope: Complete text/captions obtained; substantive pp90–107 plus conclusion109–110 inspected; parts108–109 incompletely reviewed; native pp99/102/118/123/125/133 visually verified; figures111–136 rendered privately.
reviews.what_changes: New primary descriptions replace generic lack of Ethri archaeological contexts, but do not establish identity of unread2012 title-hoard. Two wall-corner groups, floor-niche single coin, systemXIV half-shekel and reuse-controlled hiding units must remain separate.
